title: D-087 PKT-F: DXF import service + UNMOUNTED import route - an architect's DXF read by the hardened strict reader, closed rings offered as candidates the USER assigns roles to, a proposal DRAFT through the same validation contract; upload ceiling, magic-byte check, clamped limits, job/deadline/rate limit; persists nothing
objective: Build services/api/app/drawings/dxf_import.py (a pure service) and services/api/app/api/v1/dxf_import_api.py (an UNMOUNTED, flag-gated route) per plan section 4. read_dxf (accepted, hardened by M5-T097) reads the strict subset; the service lists the closed rings as candidates (layer, vertex count, measured dimensions in the declared units) and builds a proposed_massing DRAFT only from roles the USER assigns (building outline / property line / street frontage) and units the user confirms against a known dimension, through the SAME validate_proposed_massing contract. Discrepancies are shown, never auto-reconciled; nothing is labelled a city record; the draft carries input-precision provenance (imported drawing, not survey-confirmed - D-083-R006). Plan section 4 parse-time controls (b)-(e) and DB-070 (a)-(e), DB-057 (k) are acceptance criteria. The import persists NOTHING.
business_reason: The owner's CAD goal is two-way (D-087-R006): architects bring their own drawings in through the open DXF format while native DWG stays an owner licensing decision (R007).
inputs: PRODUCER MODE (binding): you are an orchestrator-dispatched subagent producer working ONLY inside your task worktree (named in the dispatch). Every file path you write is under that worktree; commit your work there as ONE commit and report its sha. Never touch the primary checkout, the ledger, or any path outside allowed_paths.

KNOWN BROKER LIMIT: documented commands may be runnable only from the worktree root - route blocked runs to harvest with an exact recipe, never predict-as-observed.

ZERO NEW DEPENDENCIES (binding; D-087-R009 + the dependency-security policy): stdlib plus already-admitted packages only (shapely/numpy/pydantic/fastapi are admitted); no lockfile or requirements change; no network access in code or tests.

HONESTY (binding; D-073-R006/D-076-R002/D-083 vocabulary): proposal-derived geometry is 'Proposed - not a city record'; a generated option is a 'Generated building option'; nothing is ever labeled permitted, approved, or 'maximum allowed building'; no legal conclusion is drawn.

UNMOUNTED ROUTE (binding; plan section 2): the route module ships UNMOUNTED - app/main.py is NOT touched; the router is asserted ABSENT from OpenAPI (mirror the accepted max_envelope_api / M5-T059 pattern); flag-gated by INTERNAL_RULE_EVAL_ENABLED with include_in_schema=False, and an absent/empty/unknown flag returns the generic 404 byte-indistinguishable from an unmounted path (app/api/v1/lot_geometry.py:100 sentinel). Mounting is PKT-H, a later gated packet. The max-envelope route stays UNMOUNTED.

JOB SAFETY (binding; DB-061 (i), the M5-T088 G5 fix (b)): the work runs OFF the event loop in a cancellable job under a per-request wall-clock deadline, with a per-caller RATE LIMIT at the route (reuse the repo's existing rate-limit mechanism - see app/api/v1/lot_geometry.py / properties.py - never a new package). Request bodies are read through the accepted T053 bounded-streaming primitives (a raw-byte ceiling BEFORE materialization). Over budget = a typed refusal, never a partial result. Only a server-generated correlation id is logged; no caller or upstream text reaches a log line (exception class + a length-bounded sanitized message at most).

PLAN SOURCE (binding): the ACCEPTED M5-T099 plan docs/design/d087-export-and-3d-viewer-plan.md - the PKT-F rows in sections 5 and 6 and section 4 (the AutoCAD round trip and the import parse-time controls (b)-(e)) - names this packet; its riders are the scope. Where the plan and a backlog row differ, the backlog row's exact wording wins and the difference goes in the report. The plan's test paths tests/api/v1/... are corrected to sit beside their service's tests (tests/scenario, tests/drawings, tests/cad): the frozen M4-T005 packet's allowed_paths glob services/api/tests/api/**, and D-087-R002 requires disjointness from frozen packets too.

SPEC SOURCE (binding): docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md DB-070 (a)-(e), DB-057 (k) and DB-061 (i) (exact wording); project-control/reports/M5-T097-G3.md / -G5.md / -G5-rework.md / -DCV.md; docs/SURVEY_DOCUMENT_FORMAT_POLICY.md (the DXF in-path); D-083-R006 (input-precision provenance: an imported drawing is never upgraded to survey precision).

PARSE-TIME CONTROLS (binding; plan section 4 (b)-(e) + DB-070): (b) a raw upload byte ceiling enforced by the T053 bounded-streaming primitives BEFORE the body is materialized; (c) read_dxf runs off the event loop in a cancellable job under a deadline with the route's rate limit; (d) a content-type + magic-byte check (ASCII DXF only; the binary-DXF sentinel refused); only exact bytes reach read_dxf and DxfLimits is CLAMPED at the seam, never built from untrusted input (DB-057 (k), DB-070 (d)); (e) nothing is persisted - an in-memory draft only (no storage, no RLS surface). Drawing text (TEXT values, layer names, $ACADVER) keeps control characters for provenance, so it is escaped on output and never logged raw; refusal details never reflect raw content unbounded (DB-070 (a), (b)). DB-070 (c) (a small digit cap on group codes) belongs to dxf_reader.py, READ-ONLY here: implement it at the seam only if it needs no reader change, else record it for the next dxf_reader touch.

CODE-GRAPH NAVIGATION BLOCK (D-066-R001; graph REGENERATED at this contract seam, 832 files / 17984 nodes / 7700 edges): dxf_reader.py is imported only by tests/drawings/test_dxf_reader.py and test_dxf_roundtrip.py (READ-ONLY here; ~613 SLOC, WARN band); validate_proposed_massing lives in app/scenario/proposal.py (READ-ONLY; consumers include max_envelope_api.py, proposal_checks_api.py, proposal_validation.py). The parallel M5-T103 rework owns app/drawings/sheet_* and pdf_object_streams.py - FORBIDDEN here. Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` before sweeps; graph ADVISORY - verify every material conclusion in actual source.

DISCOVERY ROUTING (D-069, binding): out-of-scope product/domain/defect findings go in the report's DISCOVERIES section - never fixed in-packet; the orchestrator records them in docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md at the seam.
outputs: services/api/app/drawings/dxf_import.py - the import service (candidates -> user roles -> proposal draft)
services/api/app/api/v1/dxf_import_api.py - the UNMOUNTED flag-gated import route
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (parse-time controls): an over-ceiling upload refuses before the body is materialized; a binary-DXF or non-DXF upload refuses on the magic-byte/content-type check; DxfLimits is clamped at the seam; read_dxf runs in a cancellable job under a deadline with a rate limit; each control has a test and a reddening mutation.

AS-2 (candidates -> user roles -> draft): closed rings are listed as candidates with layer and measured dimensions; a draft is built only from user-assigned roles and user-confirmed units through validate_proposed_massing; discrepancies are reported, never auto-reconciled; an unclosed or ambiguous input refuses typed.

AS-3 (honesty + provenance): nothing is labelled a city record or permitted; the draft carries input-precision provenance (imported drawing, not survey-confirmed) that no later step upgrades (D-083-R006).
AS-4 (untrusted drawing text): drawing strings are escaped on output and never logged raw; refusal details are bounded; only exact bytes are accepted (DB-070 (a), (b), (d)).
AS-5 (persists nothing + scope): no storage write anywhere; app/main.py untouched; the route is absent from OpenAPI; zero new dependencies; exactly the allowed paths; modularity_check exit 0.
